title.en: SAT R&W: Mixed conventions — opening phrases, paired words and agreement
title.uz: SAT R&W: Mixed conventions — boshlangʻich ibora, juft soʻzlar va moslik
title.ru: SAT R&W: Mixed conventions — начальный оборот, парные союзы и согласование

body.en:
Lesson 1 named the Form rules. Here are the three that the hardest questions test.
• Opening phrase: a describing phrase before the comma belongs to the noun right after the comma. Ask who or what does the action in the phrase, and put that noun first after the comma. "Like" and "Unlike" phrases compare two things of one kind: "Unlike his brother, Anvar …", never "Unlike his brother, Anvar's car …".
• Paired words: not only … but also, both … and, either … or, neither … nor. Whatever kind of part follows the first word, the same kind follows the second: "both to sew and to sell", "not only paints but also frames".
• Agreement: each, every, either, neither and one of count as one: "Each of the vans is …", "One of the keys has …". Each and every stay singular even before a list: "Every cup and plate is washed." With either … or and neither … nor, the verb agrees with the nearer subject: "Neither the driver nor the guides were …", "Either the guides or the driver is …".
body.uz:
1-darsda Form qoidalari faqat nomlangan edi. Mana eng qiyin savollar tekshiradigan uchtasi.
• Boshlangʻich ibora: verguldan oldingi tasvirlovchi ibora verguldan keyin darhol keladigan otga tegishli. Iboradagi ishni kim yoki nima bajarishini aniqlang va oʻsha otni verguldan keyin birinchi qoʻying. «Like» va «Unlike» iboralari bir turdagi ikki narsani taqqoslaydi: «Unlike his brother, Anvar …», hech qachon «Unlike his brother, Anvar’s car …» emas.
• Juft soʻzlar: not only … but also, both … and, either … or, neither … nor. Birinchi soʻzdan keyin qanday qism kelsa, ikkinchisidan keyin ham xuddi shunday qism keladi: «both to sew and to sell», «not only paints but also frames».
• Moslik: each, every, either, neither va one of bitta deb hisoblanadi: «Each of the vans is …», «One of the keys has …». Each va every roʻyxat oldida ham birlikda qoladi: «Every cup and plate is washed.» Either … or va neither … nor bilan feʼl yaqinroq turgan egaga moslashadi: «Neither the driver nor the guides were …», «Either the guides or the driver is …».
body.ru:
В уроке 1 правила Form были только названы. Вот три, которые проверяют самые сложные вопросы.
• Начальный оборот: описательный оборот перед запятой относится к существительному сразу после запятой. Спросите, кто или что выполняет действие оборота, и поставьте это существительное первым после запятой. Обороты с «Like» и «Unlike» сравнивают две вещи одного рода: «Unlike his brother, Anvar …», но никогда «Unlike his brother, Anvar's car …».
• Парные союзы: not only … but also, both … and, either … or, neither … nor. Какая часть идёт после первого слова, такая же идёт и после второго: «both to sew and to sell», «not only paints but also frames».
• Согласование: each, every, either, neither и one of считаются за одно: «Each of the vans is …», «One of the keys has …». Each и every остаются в единственном числе даже перед перечнем: «Every cup and plate is washed.» С either … or и neither … nor глагол согласуется с ближайшим подлежащим: «Neither the driver nor the guides were …», «Either the guides or the driver is …».

body.en:
Worked example: "Either the two tailors or their apprentice ______ going to finish the wedding dress by Friday."
Step 1: The options are is / are / were / have been: the verb form changes, so it is a Form question.
Step 2: Either … or: the verb agrees with the nearer subject, "their apprentice", one person.
Step 3: Friday is still ahead, so the verb is "is".
Now you: "Neither the two cooks nor the waiter ______ allowed to leave before the last table is cleared."
Step 1: The verb form changes: a Form question.
Step 2: Neither … nor: find the nearer subject.
Step 3: "The waiter" is one person, and "is cleared" says the time is now. Which verb fits?
body.uz:
Namuna: «Either the two tailors or their apprentice ______ going to finish the wedding dress by Friday.»
1-qadam: variantlar is / are / were / have been — feʼl shakli oʻzgaradi, demak bu Form savoli.
2-qadam: either … or — feʼl yaqinroq egaga moslashadi: «their apprentice», bitta odam.
3-qadam: juma hali oldinda, shuning uchun feʼl «is».
Endi siz: «Neither the two cooks nor the waiter ______ allowed to leave before the last table is cleared.»
1-qadam: feʼl shakli oʻzgaradi — Form savoli.
2-qadam: neither … nor — yaqinroq egani toping.
3-qadam: «The waiter» — bitta odam, «is cleared» esa hozirgi vaqtni bildiradi. Qaysi feʼl mos?
body.ru:
Пример: «Either the two tailors or their apprentice ______ going to finish the wedding dress by Friday.»
Шаг 1: варианты is / are / were / have been — меняется форма глагола, значит, это вопрос Form.
Шаг 2: either … or — глагол согласуется с ближайшим подлежащим: «their apprentice», один человек.
Шаг 3: пятница ещё впереди, поэтому глагол «is».
Теперь попробуйте сами: «Neither the two cooks nor the waiter ______ allowed to leave before the last table is cleared.»
Шаг 1: меняется форма глагола — вопрос Form.
Шаг 2: neither … nor — найдите ближайшее подлежащее.
Шаг 3: «The waiter» — один человек, а «is cleared» говорит, что время настоящее. Какой глагол подходит?

body.en:
Watch out for two hidden breaks.
• An owner's name after the comma is not the doer. "Born in a mountain village, the singer's songs are full of rivers" is wrong: the songs were not born. The right order: "Born in a mountain village, the singer fills her songs with rivers."
• Extra words after the second paired word break the match. "The guide not only carried the map but also she found the path" is wrong: a verb follows "not only", so a verb follows "but also": "but also found the path".
Read the whole option, not only its first word: the noun right after the comma and the part after the second paired word decide these questions.
body.uz:
Ikki yashirin xatodan ehtiyot boʻling.
• Verguldan keyingi egalik shaklidagi ism ishni bajaruvchi emas. «Born in a mountain village, the singer’s songs are full of rivers» notoʻgʻri: qoʻshiqlar tugʻilmagan. Toʻgʻri tartib: «Born in a mountain village, the singer fills her songs with rivers.»
• Ikkinchi juft soʻzdan keyingi ortiqcha soʻzlar moslikni buzadi. «The guide not only carried the map but also she found the path» notoʻgʻri: «not only» dan keyin feʼl kelgan, demak «but also» dan keyin ham feʼl keladi: «but also found the path».
Variantni faqat birinchi soʻzi boʻyicha emas, toʻliq oʻqing: verguldan keyingi ot va ikkinchi juft soʻzdan keyingi qism bu savollarni hal qiladi.
body.ru:
Осторожно: два скрытых сбоя.
• Имя владельца после запятой — не тот, кто действует. «Born in a mountain village, the singer's songs are full of rivers» — неверно: песни не рождались. Верный порядок: «Born in a mountain village, the singer fills her songs with rivers.»
• Лишние слова после второго парного слова ломают соответствие. «The guide not only carried the map but also she found the path» — неверно: после «not only» стоит глагол, значит, и после «but also» — глагол: «but also found the path».
Читайте вариант целиком, а не только первое слово: существительное сразу после запятой и часть после второго парного слова решают эти вопросы.

title.en: SAT R&W: Mixed conventions — long subjects, colons and semicolons in lists
title.uz: SAT R&W: Mixed conventions — uzun ega, ikki nuqta va roʻyxatdagi nuqtali vergul
title.ru: SAT R&W: Mixed conventions — длинное подлежащее, двоеточие и точка с запятой в перечне

body.en:
The hardest Boundaries questions test three rules.
• No mark between a subject and its verb, or between a verb and its object, however long they are. Find the verb and ask "who?" and "what?": in "The map of the valley that hung in the old school for fifty years shows every path", everything before "shows" is the subject, so no comma goes before "shows". A pair of commas around extra information is the only exception: both marks, or none.
• A colon or a dash needs a complete sentence before it. "The kit includes: a hammer and nails" is wrong, because "The kit includes" is not complete. No colon right before or right after "such as" or "including".
• A list whose items already hold commas is split by semicolons: "The tour stops at three farms: one in the hills, which grows apples; one by the river, which keeps bees; and one on the plain."
body.uz:
Eng qiyin Boundaries savollari uchta qoidani tekshiradi.
• Ega bilan feʼl orasiga ham, feʼl bilan uning toʻldiruvchisi orasiga ham, ular qanchalik uzun boʻlmasin, belgi qoʻyilmaydi. Feʼlni toping va «kim?», «nimani?» deb soʻrang: «The map of the valley that hung in the old school for fifty years shows every path» gapida «shows» dan oldingi hamma soʻzlar ega, shuning uchun «shows» oldidan vergul qoʻyilmaydi. Yagona istisno — qoʻshimcha maʼlumotni oʻrab turgan juft vergul: ikkala belgi ham, yoki hech biri.
• Ikki nuqta yoki tiredan oldin toʻliq gap kerak. «The kit includes: a hammer and nails» notoʻgʻri, chunki «The kit includes» toʻliq emas. «Such as» yoki «including» dan bevosita oldin ham, keyin ham ikki nuqta qoʻyilmaydi.
• Qismlari ichida vergul bor roʻyxat nuqtali vergul bilan ajratiladi: «The tour stops at three farms: one in the hills, which grows apples; one by the river, which keeps bees; and one on the plain.»
body.ru:
Самые сложные вопросы Boundaries проверяют три правила.
• Между подлежащим и сказуемым, а также между глаголом и его дополнением знак не ставится, какими бы длинными они ни были. Найдите глагол и спросите «кто?» и «что?»: в «The map of the valley that hung in the old school for fifty years shows every path» всё до «shows» — подлежащее, поэтому перед «shows» запятой нет. Единственное исключение — пара запятых вокруг дополнительной информации: оба знака или ни одного.
• Перед двоеточием или тире должно стоять полное предложение. «The kit includes: a hammer and nails» — неверно, потому что «The kit includes» — неполное. Ни прямо перед «such as» или «including», ни сразу после них двоеточие не ставится.
• Перечень, пункты которого уже содержат запятые, делят точками с запятой: «The tour stops at three farms: one in the hills, which grows apples; one by the river, which keeps bees; and one on the plain.»

body.en:
Worked example: "The three tall pines that the first families of the village planted beside the old ______ shade to anyone who stops there for a drink."
Step 1: Find the verb: "give".
Step 2: Ask "what gives?": "The three tall pines that the first families of the village planted beside the old well". All of that is the subject.
Step 3: No mark goes between a subject and its verb: "well give".
Now you: "Everyone who signed up for the night walk through the forest with the park ranger last ______ a map of the trails as a gift at the gate."
Step 1: Find the verb: "received".
Step 2: Ask "who received?": everything from "Everyone" to "weekend" is the subject.
Step 3: Which choice keeps the subject and its verb together?
body.uz:
Namuna: «The three tall pines that the first families of the village planted beside the old ______ shade to anyone who stops there for a drink.»
1-qadam: feʼlni toping: «give».
2-qadam: «nima beradi?» deb soʻrang: «The three tall pines that the first families of the village planted beside the old well». Bularning hammasi — ega.
3-qadam: ega bilan feʼl orasiga belgi qoʻyilmaydi: «well give».
Endi siz: «Everyone who signed up for the night walk through the forest with the park ranger last ______ a map of the trails as a gift at the gate.»
1-qadam: feʼlni toping: «received».
2-qadam: «kim oldi?» deb soʻrang: «Everyone» dan «weekend» gacha hammasi — ega.
3-qadam: qaysi variant ega bilan feʼlni birga saqlaydi?
body.ru:
Пример: «The three tall pines that the first families of the village planted beside the old ______ shade to anyone who stops there for a drink.»
Шаг 1: найдите глагол: «give».
Шаг 2: спросите «что даёт?»: «The three tall pines that the first families of the village planted beside the old well». Всё это — подлежащее.
Шаг 3: между подлежащим и сказуемым знак не ставится: «well give».
Теперь попробуйте сами: «Everyone who signed up for the night walk through the forest with the park ranger last ______ a map of the trails as a gift at the gate.»
Шаг 1: найдите глагол: «received».
Шаг 2: спросите «кто получил?»: всё от «Everyone» до «weekend» — подлежащее.
Шаг 3: какой вариант оставляет подлежащее и сказуемое вместе?

body.en:
Watch out for two traps.
• A verb and what it names stay together, even when a long list follows. "The crew needed: rope, nails, and paint" is wrong. Complete the sentence first, then add the colon: "The crew needed three things: rope, nails, and paint."
• In a list split by semicolons, every break between items takes a semicolon, including the one before "and", while the commas stay inside each item: "Nodira, a nurse; Davron, a driver; and Aziz, a cook". A comma at one of those breaks makes a name and a job look like two different people.
body.uz:
Ikki tuzoqdan ehtiyot boʻling.
• Feʼl va u nomlagan narsa birga turadi, keyin uzun roʻyxat kelsa ham. «The crew needed: rope, nails, and paint» notoʻgʻri. Avval gapni toʻliq qiling, keyin ikki nuqta qoʻying: «The crew needed three things: rope, nails, and paint.»
• Nuqtali vergul bilan ajratilgan roʻyxatda qismlar orasidagi har bir chegara, «and» oldidagisi ham, nuqtali vergul oladi, vergullar esa har bir qism ichida qoladi: «Nodira, a nurse; Davron, a driver; and Aziz, a cook». Shu chegaralardan birida vergul tursa, ism va kasb ikki xil odamdek koʻrinadi.
body.ru:
Осторожно: две ловушки.
• Глагол и его дополнение не разделяются знаком, даже если дальше идёт длинный перечень. «The crew needed: rope, nails, and paint» — неверно. Сначала закончите предложение, потом ставьте двоеточие: «The crew needed three things: rope, nails, and paint.»
• В перечне, разделённом точками с запятой, каждая граница между пунктами, включая ту, что перед «and», получает точку с запятой, а запятые остаются внутри пунктов: «Nodira, a nurse; Davron, a driver; and Aziz, a cook». Запятая на одной из этих границ превращает имя и профессию в двух разных людей.

title.en: SAT R&W: Mixed Expression of Ideas — Transitions: the precise link
title.uz: SAT R&W: Aralash Expression of Ideas — Transitions: aniq bogʻlovchi
title.ru: SAT R&W: Expression of Ideas, смешанные задания — Transitions: точная связка

body.en:
Lesson 1 listed the hard links. Now tell the close ones apart: ask what the sentence after the blank does to the one before it.
• Going further: In fact, Indeed. The second sentence makes the same point stronger or proves it.
• Saying it again: In other words, That is. The same point in plainer words; nothing new is added. That is also explains a term.
• Detail: Specifically, In particular. A general point, then its exact parts or one named case.
• Granting, then insisting: Admittedly, Granted. The sentence admits a weak spot in the writer's own point; the next one turns back with Still or Even so.
• Concluding: Thus draws what follows from the facts before it; Ultimately gives the final outcome after a long process.
body.uz:
1-darsda qiyin bogʻlovchilar sanab oʻtilgan edi. Endi bir-biriga yaqinlarini ajrating: boʻsh joydan keyingi gap oldingi gapga nima qilishini aniqlang.
• Kuchaytirish: In fact, Indeed. Ikkinchi gap xuddi shu fikrni kuchliroq qiladi yoki isbotlaydi.
• Qayta aytish: In other words, That is. Oʻsha fikr oddiyroq soʻzlar bilan; yangi narsa qoʻshilmaydi. That is atamani izohlash uchun ham keladi.
• Tafsilot: Specifically, In particular. Umumiy fikr, keyin uning aniq qismlari yoki bitta nomlangan holat.
• Tan olib, turib olish: Admittedly, Granted. Gap muallif fikrining zaif tomonini tan oladi; keyingi gap Still yoki Even so bilan asosiy fikrga qaytadi.
• Xulosa: Thus oldingi faktlardan kelib chiqadigan natijani aytadi; Ultimately uzoq jarayondan keyingi yakuniy natijani beradi.
body.ru:
В уроке 1 сложные связки были перечислены. Теперь различайте близкие: спросите, что предложение после пропуска делает с предыдущим.
• Усиление: In fact, Indeed. Второе предложение делает ту же мысль сильнее или доказывает её.
• Пересказ: In other words, That is. Та же мысль простыми словами; ничего нового. That is ещё и объясняет термин.
• Деталь: Specifically, In particular. Общая мысль, затем её точные части или один названный случай.
• Уступка, затем возврат к своей мысли: Admittedly, Granted. Предложение признаёт слабое место в мысли самого автора; следующее возвращается к главному со Still или Even so.
• Вывод: Thus выводит следствие из фактов перед ним; Ultimately называет окончательный итог долгого процесса.

body.en:
Worked example: "The ferry crew prepares for storms long before they arrive. ______ the captain reads the coast forecast every evening and ties down the deck chairs whenever the wind passes forty kilometers an hour."
Step 1: What does the second sentence do? It names the exact things the crew does.
Step 2: A general point, then its exact parts: a detail link.
Step 3: "Specifically," fits. "In fact," would need a stronger claim, not the parts of the same one.
Now you: "The old carpenter tells every new apprentice that a good joint "needs no glue to hold." ______ its parts should fit so tightly that they stay together without any glue at all."
Step 1: The first sentence gives the carpenter's words; the second says what they mean in plain words.
Step 2: Nothing new or stronger is added: the same point, said again.
Step 3: Which link fits the blank?
body.uz:
Namuna: «The ferry crew prepares for storms long before they arrive. ______ the captain reads the coast forecast every evening and ties down the deck chairs whenever the wind passes forty kilometers an hour.»
1-qadam: ikkinchi gap nima qiladi? U ekipaj aynan nima qilishini aytadi.
2-qadam: umumiy fikr, keyin uning aniq qismlari — tafsilot bogʻlovchisi.
3-qadam: «Specifically,» mos. «In fact,» uchun kuchliroq fikr kerak edi, oʻsha fikrning qismlari emas.
Endi siz: «The old carpenter tells every new apprentice that a good joint "needs no glue to hold." ______ its parts should fit so tightly that they stay together without any glue at all.»
1-qadam: birinchi gapda duradgorning soʻzlari bor; ikkinchisi ularning maʼnosini oddiy soʻzlar bilan aytadi.
2-qadam: yangi yoki kuchliroq hech narsa qoʻshilmaydi — oʻsha fikr qayta aytilgan.
3-qadam: boʻsh joyga qaysi bogʻlovchi mos?
body.ru:
Пример: «The ferry crew prepares for storms long before they arrive. ______ the captain reads the coast forecast every evening and ties down the deck chairs whenever the wind passes forty kilometers an hour.»
Шаг 1: что делает второе предложение? Оно называет, что именно делает команда.
Шаг 2: общая мысль, затем её точные части — связка детали.
Шаг 3: подходит «Specifically,». Для «In fact,» нужна была бы более сильная мысль, а не части той же.
Теперь попробуйте сами: «The old carpenter tells every new apprentice that a good joint "needs no glue to hold." ______ its parts should fit so tightly that they stay together without any glue at all.»
Шаг 1: в первом предложении — слова плотника; второе простыми словами говорит, что они значат.
Шаг 2: ничего нового или более сильного не добавлено — та же мысль сказана снова.
Шаг 3: какая связка подходит к пропуску?

body.en:
Two traps among close links.
1. In fact is not In other words. If the second sentence only says the first again, nothing is stronger, so In fact is wrong. If it goes further, with a bigger number or a stronger claim, In other words is wrong.
2. Read past the blank. Admittedly or Granted fits only if the writer turns back to the main point afterwards ("Still, …", "Even so, …"). If the text ends on the weak spot, the sentence is not a concession. The sentence after the blank can also rule out a link that seemed to fit: check the whole text.
body.uz:
Yaqin bogʻlovchilar orasidagi ikki tuzoq.
1. In fact — bu In other words emas. Ikkinchi gap birinchisini shunchaki qayta aytsa, hech narsa kuchaymaydi, demak In fact notoʻgʻri. Agar u kattaroq son yoki kuchliroq daʼvo bilan uzoqroqqa borsa, In other words notoʻgʻri.
2. Boʻsh joydan keyingi gapni ham oʻqing. Admittedly yoki Granted faqat muallif keyin asosiy fikrga qaytsa mos keladi («Still, …», «Even so, …»). Matn zaif tomon bilan tugasa, bu gap tan olish emas. Boʻsh joydan keyingi gap mos koʻringan bogʻlovchini ham chiqarib tashlashi mumkin: matnni oxirigacha tekshiring.
body.ru:
Две ловушки среди близких связок.
1. In fact — это не In other words. Если второе предложение лишь повторяет первое, ничего не усиливается, и In fact не подходит. Если оно идёт дальше — большее число, более сильное утверждение, — не подходит In other words.
2. Читайте и то, что после пропуска. Admittedly или Granted подходят, только если автор потом возвращается к главной мысли («Still, …», «Even so, …»). Если текст кончается слабым местом, это не уступка. Предложение после пропуска может исключить и связку, которая казалась верной: проверяйте текст целиком.

title.en: SAT R&W: Mixed Expression of Ideas — Rhetorical Synthesis: hard goals
title.uz: SAT R&W: Aralash Expression of Ideas — Rhetorical Synthesis: qiyin maqsadlar
title.ru: SAT R&W: Expression of Ideas, смешанные задания — Rhetorical Synthesis: сложные цели

body.en:
Hard notes questions add a twist to the goal. Read the goal word by word, then cross out every option that misses any part of it.
• Two-part goals ("explain why … and present the result"): many options meet only one half. Count the halves in the goal, then find both in the option.
• The reader: "an audience unfamiliar with X" needs to be told what X is. "An audience already familiar with X" needs no definition: give the new point.
• "Emphasize X while acknowledging Y": X is the main part of the sentence; Y sits in an "although", "though" or "while" part. An option that puts Y in the main part has the halves backwards.
• "A general statement": one claim that covers all the notes, not one note's detail.
Copy numbers and names exactly as the notes give them.
body.uz:
Qiyin qaydlar savollarida maqsadga qoʻshimcha shart qoʻshiladi. Maqsadni soʻzma-soʻz oʻqing, keyin uning biror qismini oʻtkazib yuborgan har bir variantni chizib tashlang.
• Ikki qismli maqsad («explain why … and present the result»): koʻp variantlar faqat bitta yarmini bajaradi. Maqsaddagi qismlarni sanang, keyin ikkalasini variantdan toping.
• Auditoriya: «an audience unfamiliar with X» uchun X nimaligini aytish kerak. «An audience already familiar with X» uchun taʼrif kerak emas — yangi fikrni bering.
• «Emphasize X while acknowledging Y»: X — gapning asosiy qismi; Y esa «although», «though» yoki «while» qismida turadi. Y ni asosiy qismga qoʻygan variantda yarimlar teskari.
• «A general statement»: bitta qaydning tafsiloti emas, barcha qaydlarni qamraydigan bitta daʼvo.
Son va ismlarni qaydlarda qanday boʻlsa, xuddi shunday koʻchiring.
body.ru:
В сложных вопросах на заметки у цели есть подвох. Читайте цель слово за словом, затем вычеркните каждый вариант, который упускает хоть одну её часть.
• Цель из двух частей («explain why … and present the result»): многие варианты выполняют только одну половину. Посчитайте части в цели, затем найдите обе в варианте.
• Читатель: если в цели «an audience unfamiliar with X», нужно сказать, что такое X. Если «an audience already familiar with X», определение не нужно — сообщите новое.
• «Emphasize X while acknowledging Y»: X — главная часть предложения; Y стоит в части с «although», «though» или «while». Вариант, где Y в главной части, перевернул половины.
• «A general statement»: одно утверждение, которое охватывает все заметки, а не деталь одной из них.
Числа и имена переписывайте точно так, как в заметках.

body.en:
Worked example. Notes:
• A mountain dairy makes cheese from the milk of 80 cows.
• Until 2024, it heated the milk with a wood stove.
• In 2024, it switched to an electric boiler.
• Solar panels on the barn roof power the boiler.
Goal: to explain how the dairy now heats its milk and what it used before.
Step 1: Two halves: how it heats the milk now, and what it used before.
Step 2: "The dairy makes cheese from the milk of 80 cows" gives neither half. Out.
Step 3: Answer: "The dairy now heats its milk with an electric boiler powered by solar panels on the barn roof; until 2024, it used a wood stove."
Now you: While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• The Tepalik weather station stands at 2,100 meters in the hills above a farming valley.
• It has recorded rain and temperature every day since 1987.
• Each morning at six, its staff of three send up a weather balloon.
• In 2025, the station added a sensor that measures frost on the ground.
• The frost readings reach farmers in the valley within ten minutes.
The student wants to present the newest work of the Tepalik station to an audience already familiar with the station.
Step 1: The audience already knows the station: skip what it is and where it stands.
Step 2: The newest work is the 2025 sensor and what happens to its readings.
Step 3: Answer: ?
body.uz:
Yechilgan misol. Notes:
• A mountain dairy makes cheese from the milk of 80 cows.
• Until 2024, it heated the milk with a wood stove.
• In 2024, it switched to an electric boiler.
• Solar panels on the barn roof power the boiler.
Goal: to explain how the dairy now heats its milk and what it used before.
1-qadam: ikki qism — sutni hozir qanday isitadi va avval nima ishlatgan.
2-qadam: «The dairy makes cheese from the milk of 80 cows» hech bir qismini bermaydi. Chiqarib tashlanadi.
3-qadam: Javob: «The dairy now heats its milk with an electric boiler powered by solar panels on the barn roof; until 2024, it used a wood stove.»
Endi siz: While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• The Tepalik weather station stands at 2,100 meters in the hills above a farming valley.
• It has recorded rain and temperature every day since 1987.
• Each morning at six, its staff of three send up a weather balloon.
• In 2025, the station added a sensor that measures frost on the ground.
• The frost readings reach farmers in the valley within ten minutes.
The student wants to present the newest work of the Tepalik station to an audience already familiar with the station.
1-qadam: tinglovchilar stansiyani allaqachon biladi — u nima ekanini va qayerda turganini aytish shart emas.
2-qadam: eng yangi ish — 2025-yilgi sensor va uning maʼlumotlari bilan nima boʻlishi.
3-qadam: Javob: ?
body.ru:
Разбор. Заметки:
• A mountain dairy makes cheese from the milk of 80 cows.
• Until 2024, it heated the milk with a wood stove.
• In 2024, it switched to an electric boiler.
• Solar panels on the barn roof power the boiler.
Цель: «to explain how the dairy now heats its milk and what it used before».
Шаг 1: две части — как молоко греют теперь и чем грели раньше.
Шаг 2: «The dairy makes cheese from the milk of 80 cows» не даёт ни одной части. Отпадает.
Шаг 3: Ответ: «The dairy now heats its milk with an electric boiler powered by solar panels on the barn roof; until 2024, it used a wood stove.»
Теперь попробуйте сами: While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• The Tepalik weather station stands at 2,100 meters in the hills above a farming valley.
• It has recorded rain and temperature every day since 1987.
• Each morning at six, its staff of three send up a weather balloon.
• In 2025, the station added a sensor that measures frost on the ground.
• The frost readings reach farmers in the valley within ten minutes.
The student wants to present the newest work of the Tepalik station to an audience already familiar with the station.
Шаг 1: слушатели уже знают станцию — не нужно объяснять, что это и где она стоит.
Шаг 2: новейшая работа — датчик 2025 года и то, что происходит с его данными.
Шаг 3: Ответ: ?

body.en:
Two traps in hard goals.
1. The backwards emphasis. Goal: "emphasize that the pump is cheap while acknowledging that it is slow." "Although the new pump is cheap, it fills the tank slowly" stresses the slowness, because the main part of a sentence carries the weight. The right order: "Although it fills the tank slowly, the new pump is cheap."
2. True but beside the goal. An option can copy two notes exactly and still be wrong if neither is what the goal asks for. Check each option against the goal, not against the notes.
body.uz:
Qiyin maqsadlardagi ikki tuzoq.
1. Teskari urgʻu. Maqsad: «emphasize that the pump is cheap while acknowledging that it is slow». «Although the new pump is cheap, it fills the tank slowly» sekinlikka urgʻu beradi, chunki urgʻuni gapning asosiy qismi oladi. Toʻgʻri tartib: «Although it fills the tank slowly, the new pump is cheap.»
2. Toʻgʻri, lekin maqsaddan tashqari. Variant ikki qaydni aynan koʻchirgan boʻlsa ham, ulardan hech biri maqsad soʻragan narsa boʻlmasa, notoʻgʻri. Har bir variantni qaydlar bilan emas, maqsad bilan solishtiring.
body.ru:
Две ловушки в сложных целях.
1. Обратный акцент. Цель: «emphasize that the pump is cheap while acknowledging that it is slow». «Although the new pump is cheap, it fills the tank slowly» подчёркивает, что насос медленный, потому что акцент несёт главная часть предложения. Верный порядок: «Although it fills the tank slowly, the new pump is cheap.»
2. Верно, но мимо цели. Вариант может дословно повторять две заметки и всё же быть неверным, если ни одна из них не то, что просит цель. Сверяйте каждый вариант с целью, а не с заметками.

stem.en:
Most bakeries in the district switched to electric ovens many years ago to save time. Unlike them, ______

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

options.en: the small shop by the bus station still bakes its bread in a clay oven.
the bread at the small shop by the bus station still comes out of a clay oven.
a clay oven is still where the small shop by the bus station bakes its bread.
the owner of the small shop by the bus station still bakes in a clay oven.

why.en: "Unlike them" compares bakeries, so another bakery must follow the comma: "the small shop", not its bread, its oven or its owner.
why.uz: «Unlike them» novvoyxonalarni taqqoslaydi, shuning uchun verguldan keyin boshqa novvoyxona keladi: «the small shop», uning noni, tandiri yoki egasi emas.
why.ru: «Unlike them» сравнивает пекарни, поэтому после запятой должна стоять другая пекарня: «the small shop», а не её хлеб, печь или владелец.

instructions.en: Choose the option that follows the rules of standard written English.
instructions.uz: Standart yozma ingliz tili qoidalariga mos keladigan variantni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите вариант, который соответствует нормам письменного английского языка.

stem.en:
Neither the two cooks nor the waiter ______ allowed to leave before the last table is cleared.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: With neither … nor, the verb agrees with the nearer subject, "the waiter", one person, and "is cleared" puts it in the present: "is".
why.uz: Neither … nor bilan feʼl yaqinroq egaga moslashadi: «the waiter» — bitta odam, «is cleared» esa hozirgi zamon, shuning uchun «is».
why.ru: С neither … nor глагол согласуется с ближайшим подлежащим: «the waiter» — один человек, а «is cleared» — настоящее время, поэтому «is».

instructions.en: Choose the option that follows the rules of standard written English.
instructions.uz: Standart yozma ingliz tili qoidalariga mos keladigan variantni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите вариант, который соответствует нормам письменного английского языка.

stem.en:
The sets in Feruza's films look old and lived-in, down to the scratches on the tables. Trained as a carpenter before she ever touched a camera, ______

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

options.en: Feruza builds every one of them herself, using wood from old houses.
Feruza's sets are built by her own hands from the wood of old houses.
the sets are built by Feruza herself from the wood of old houses.
every one of them is built by Feruza herself from the wood of old houses.

why.en: The phrase describes someone trained as a carpenter, so "Feruza" must follow the comma; "Feruza's sets" puts the sets first, and sets were never trained.
why.uz: Ibora duradgorlikni oʻrgangan odamni tasvirlaydi, shuning uchun verguldan keyin «Feruza» keladi; «Feruza’s sets» da avval dekoratsiyalar turibdi, ular esa oʻrganmagan.
why.ru: Оборот описывает того, кто учился на плотника, поэтому после запятой нужно «Feruza»; в «Feruza's sets» первыми стоят декорации, а они не учились.

instructions.en: Choose the option that follows the rules of standard written English.
instructions.uz: Standart yozma ingliz tili qoidalariga mos keladigan variantni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите вариант, который соответствует нормам письменного английского языка.

stem.en:
The repair shop on the corner fixes almost anything with a ______ old radios, broken lamps, and even electric kettles.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: "The repair shop … anything with a plug" is complete and a list follows, so a colon fits: "plug:". No colon goes after "such as" or "including".
why.uz: «The repair shop … anything with a plug» — toʻliq gap, keyin roʻyxat keladi, shuning uchun ikki nuqta: «plug:». «Such as» yoki «including» dan keyin ikki nuqta qoʻyilmaydi.
why.ru: «The repair shop … anything with a plug» — полное предложение, за ним перечень, поэтому двоеточие: «plug:». После «such as» и «including» двоеточие не ставится.

instructions.en: Choose the punctuation that correctly joins or separates the parts of the sentence.
instructions.uz: Gap qismlarini toʻgʻri bogʻlaydigan yoki ajratadigan tinish belgisini tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите знаки препинания, которые правильно соединяют или разделяют части предложения.

stem.en:
Everyone who signed up for the night walk through the forest with the park ranger last ______ a map of the trails as a gift at the gate.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: Everything from "Everyone" to "weekend" is the subject of "received", and no mark goes between a subject and its verb: "weekend received".
why.uz: «Everyone» dan «weekend» gacha — hammasi «received» ning egasi, ega bilan feʼl orasiga belgi qoʻyilmaydi: «weekend received».
why.ru: Всё от «Everyone» до «weekend» — подлежащее к «received», а между подлежащим и сказуемым знак не ставится: «weekend received».

instructions.en: Choose the punctuation that correctly joins or separates the parts of the sentence.
instructions.uz: Gap qismlarini toʻgʻri bogʻlaydigan yoki ajratadigan tinish belgisini tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите знаки препинания, которые правильно соединяют или разделяют части предложения.

stem.en:
The festival hired three local cooks: Ozoda, who bakes the flatbread; Rustam, who grills the ______ Gulnora, who makes the sweets.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: The items hold commas ("Ozoda, who bakes…"), so semicolons split them, including the break before "and": "meat; and".
why.uz: Roʻyxat qismlari ichida vergul bor («Ozoda, who bakes…»), shuning uchun ular nuqtali vergul bilan ajratiladi, «and» oldidagi joy ham: «meat; and».
why.ru: Внутри пунктов есть запятые («Ozoda, who bakes…»), поэтому их делят точки с запятой, и перед «and» тоже: «meat; and».

instructions.en: Choose the punctuation that correctly joins or separates the parts of the sentence.
instructions.uz: Gap qismlarini toʻgʻri bogʻlaydigan yoki ajratadigan tinish belgisini tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите знаки препинания, которые правильно соединяют или разделяют части предложения.

stem.en:
The mechanic at the bus depot did not just fix the old engine. ______ she rebuilt it so well that the bus now uses less fuel than the new ones parked beside it.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

why.en: The second sentence goes further than "did not just fix": she rebuilt the engine and made it better than new. That stronger point takes "In fact,".
why.uz: Ikkinchi gap «did not just fix» dan uzoqroqqa boradi: u dvigatelni qayta yigʻib, yangisidan ham yaxshi qilgan. Bunday kuchliroq fikrga «In fact,» mos.
why.ru: Второе предложение идёт дальше «did not just fix»: она пересобрала двигатель и сделала его лучше нового. Такому усилению подходит «In fact,».

instructions.en: Choose the linking word or phrase that fits the logic between the ideas.
instructions.uz: Fikrlar orasidagi mantiqqa mos keladigan bogʻlovchi soʻz yoki iborani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите связующее слово или выражение, которое передаёт логическую связь между мыслями.

stem.en:
The old carpenter tells every new apprentice that a good joint "needs no glue to hold." ______ its parts should fit so tightly that they stay together without any glue at all.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

why.en: The second sentence says what the carpenter's words mean, in plain terms, and adds nothing stronger. A restatement takes "In other words,".
why.uz: Ikkinchi gap duradgor soʻzlarining maʼnosini oddiy qilib aytadi va kuchliroq hech narsa qoʻshmaydi. Qayta aytishga «In other words,» mos.
why.ru: Второе предложение простыми словами объясняет слова плотника и ничего не усиливает. Пересказу подходит «In other words,».

instructions.en: Choose the linking word or phrase that fits the logic between the ideas.
instructions.uz: Fikrlar orasidagi mantiqqa mos keladigan bogʻlovchi soʻz yoki iborani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите связующее слово или выражение, которое передаёт логическую связь между мыслями.

stem.en:
Farmers in the valley say the new weather station has already paid for itself: its frost warnings saved last spring's apricot harvest. ______ the station cost far more than the rain gauge it replaced, and it needs a technician from the city twice a year. Still, no farmer wants the old gauge back.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

why.en: The blank sentence admits the station's costs, a weak spot, and "Still" then turns back to the main point. That concession takes "Admittedly,".
why.uz: Boʻsh joydagi gap stansiyaning xarajatini — zaif tomonini tan oladi, «Still» esa asosiy fikrga qaytaradi. Bunday tan olishga «Admittedly,» mos.
why.ru: Предложение с пропуском признаёт слабое место — расходы на станцию, а «Still» возвращает к главной мысли. Такому признанию подходит «Admittedly,».

instructions.en: Choose the linking word or phrase that fits the logic between the ideas.
instructions.uz: Fikrlar orasidagi mantiqqa mos keladigan bogʻlovchi soʻz yoki iborani tanlang.
instructions.ru: Выберите связующее слово или выражение, которое передаёт логическую связь между мыслями.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• Dilfuza keeps 60 beehives on her farm.
• She moves the hives to follow the flowers as they bloom.
• In spring, the hives stand in the apricot orchards of the valley.
• In summer, they stand in the mountain meadows.
• The apricot honey is light; the mountain honey is dark.

The student wants to explain why Dilfuza moves her hives and identify one result of the moves.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Dilfuza moves her 60 hives to follow the flowers as they bloom, and the moves give her both a light apricot honey and a dark mountain honey.
Dilfuza's hives stand in the valley's apricot orchards in spring and in the mountain meadows in summer.
Dilfuza's apricot honey is light in color, while the honey from her mountain meadows is dark.
Dilfuza moves her 60 hives so that they can follow the flowers as they bloom.

why.en: The goal has two halves: why she moves the hives and one result. Only the choice joining "to follow the flowers" with the two honeys gives both.
why.uz: Maqsad ikki qismli: nega ari uyalarini koʻchiradi va bitta natija. Faqat «to follow the flowers» ni ikki xil asal bilan bogʻlagan variant ikkalasini beradi.
why.ru: У цели две части: зачем она перевозит ульи и один результат. Обе даёт только вариант, где «to follow the flowers» связано с двумя видами мёда.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• The Tepalik weather station stands at 2,100 meters in the hills above a farming valley.
• It has recorded rain and temperature every day since 1987.
• Each morning at six, its staff of three send up a weather balloon.
• In 2025, the station added a sensor that measures frost on the ground.
• The frost readings reach farmers in the valley within ten minutes.

The student wants to present the newest work of the Tepalik station to an audience already familiar with the station.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Since 2025, the Tepalik station has also measured frost on the ground, and its readings reach valley farmers within ten minutes.
The Tepalik weather station, which stands at 2,100 meters above a farming valley, has recorded rain and temperature every day since 1987.
Each morning at six, the three staff members of the Tepalik weather station send up a weather balloon.
Weather stations such as Tepalik record rain and temperature high in the hills above farming valleys.

why.en: The audience knows the station, so skip what it is. Only the choice about the 2025 frost sensor and its ten-minute readings presents its newest work.
why.uz: Tinglovchilar stansiyani biladi, demak u nimaligini aytish shart emas. Eng yangi ishni faqat 2025-yilgi qirov sensori va uning oʻn daqiqada yetib boradigan maʼlumotlari haqidagi variant beradi.
why.ru: Слушатели знают станцию, поэтому не нужно объяснять, что это. Новую работу показывает только вариант о датчике заморозков 2025 года.

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.

stem.en:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:

• A theater crew built a revolving stage for its spring show.
• The stage turns a full circle in 40 seconds.
• It lets the crew change between all 9 sets without closing the curtain.
• It cost 3 times as much as the old fixed stage.
• It took the crew 5 months to build.

The student wants to emphasize what the new stage made possible while acknowledging its cost.

Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

options.en: Although it cost 3 times as much as the old fixed stage, the new revolving stage lets the crew change between all 9 sets without closing the curtain.
Although the new revolving stage lets the crew change between all 9 sets without closing the curtain, it cost 3 times as much as the old fixed stage.
The new revolving stage, which took the crew 5 months to build, turns a full circle in 40 seconds.
The new revolving stage lets the crew change between all 9 sets of the spring show without closing the curtain.

why.en: What the stage made possible must be the main part, and the cost the "although" part. Only the choice opening "Although it cost 3 times as much" does that.
why.uz: Sahna imkon bergan narsa asosiy qism, narx esa «although» qismi boʻlishi kerak. Buni faqat «Although it cost 3 times as much» bilan boshlangan variant qiladi.
why.ru: То, что дала сцена, должно быть главной частью, а цена — частью с «although». Так построен только вариант, начинающийся с «Although it cost 3 times as much».

instructions.en: Read the student's notes. Choose the sentence that best meets the stated goal.
instructions.uz: Oʻquvchining qaydlarini oʻqing. Koʻrsatilgan maqsadga eng yaxshi erishadigan gapni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте заметки ученика. Выберите предложение, которое лучше всего достигает указанной цели.
